title: Rewriting SymCrypt in Rust to modernize Microsoft’s cryptographic library
description: We're rewriting parts of Microsoft's SymCrypt cryptographic library in Rust to improve memory safety and defend against side-channel attacks, enabling formal verification while maintaining backward compatibility via a Rust-to-C compiler. The post Rewriting SymCrypt in Rust to modernize Microsoft’s cryptographic library appeared first on Microsoft Research .
